description: This file defines database schema types, database setup, migration, and plugin logic for the Notesnook project, including handling of SQLite database configuration, migrations, and custom boolean transformation.

classes.name: SqliteBooleanPlugin
classes.description: A Kysely plugin that transforms boolean values stored as integers in SQLite to JavaScript booleans and applies custom row data mappers.

classes.name: SqliteBooleanTransformer
classes.description: Transforms query values and results to handle boolean serialization/deserialization for SQLite.

methods.name: setupDatabase
methods.description: Configures SQLite PRAGMA settings based on provided options.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Runs database migrations and handles migration errors.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Kysely database instance with optional migration and initialization.

methods.name: changeDatabasePassword
methods.description: Rekeys the SQLite database with a new password.

methods.name: isFalse
methods.description: Creates an expression to check if a column is false or null.
